subject: Timeline lock: CAIQ dry-run, 90m demo slot, and minimal evidence bundle
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmelabs.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acmelabs.com
Date: 2026-09-22T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ kickoff + suggested windows

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for taking this on. We at Acme Labs are trying to wrap our CAIQ/ SIG intake quickly to meet an internal audit next month. Would Redwood be available for a short dry-run + demo that covers:
- 60–90m live walkthrough (recorded)
- minimal evidence bundle we can expect from you (logs, config snapshots, IAM mapping)
- a single S3 link or Drive folder for artifacts

Our preferred windows (PST): Sep 23 10:00–12:00, or Sep 24 14:00–16:00. If neither works, please propose two alternatives.

Also: can you confirm a single point of contact for evidence handoff and a small template for required artifacts?

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Sr. Security Program Manager
Acme Labs

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff + suggested windows

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can run a 90-minute dry-run and record it. Proposed plan:
1) Dry-run + demo (90m): short intro (10m), CAIQ mapping (25m), demo of log/metrics flow (30m), Q&A + next steps (25m).
2) Minimal artifact bundle:
   - config snapshot (JSON) for the customer tenancy
   - 72-hour log sample (rotate/trim)
   - access list / IAM mapping
   - CAIQ answers matrix we complete
3) Evidence handoff: single Drive folder (we'll upload), with one owner at Redwood and one at Acme for signoff.

I can own the CAIQ matrix and the Drive upload. Ben will own log samples; Marissa will help coordinate any SOC2-specific attestation language for procurement. Attached: evidence_template.xlsx to show the minimal fields we need.

Of your two windows, Sep 23 10:00–11:30 PST works for us. Please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite (Zoom + recording consent). If you want Sep 24 instead, we can do 14:00–15:30 PST but prefer the 23rd to keep momentum.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: evidence_template.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, template)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff + suggested windows

Quick note — we can produce a 72-hour log snapshot and a short README describing what each log stream contains (auth, inference requests, infra events). I’ll prepare a short guide for sampling and redaction. See stub: log-sample-guide.pdf attached.

Operational notes:
- We will redact PII and customer payloads by default; if you need raw payloads we’ll coordinate an escalation with legal and your security team.
- S3/Drive access: we’ll provide a temporary, time-limited link and rotate credentials post-handoff.

Ben
Senior Customer Success Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: log-sample-guide.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmelabs.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff + suggested windows

Jordan / Rachel —

Confirmed for Sep 23 10:00–11:30 PST. I’ll send the invite with the Zoom link and include a short run-of-show in the calendar description. For procurement and legal: we can include a one-page attestation summary post-demo that notes typical retention settings and key controls.

Jordan — to help speed your review, I’ve attached a small sample archive (sample-logs.tar.gz) with anonymized log lines and a YAML manifest that explains field mappings. If you want us to include any additional telemetry (e.g., GPU scheduling events, KV cache operations), flag it and we’ll add it to the bundle.

Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample-logs.tar.gz (archive, ~4MB)

From: Elena Marques <elena@corp-ops.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmelabs.com>
Cc: security@acmelabs.com
Date: 2026-09-23T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline lock: CAIQ dry-run, 90m demo slot, and minimal evidence bundle

Thanks everyone — Sep 23 10:00 PST is locked in. HubSpot link for the deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/12345 (I’ve added the CAIQ task to the intake).

Quick asks before the call:
- Rachel: please drop the Drive folder link and the evidence_template.xlsx into the HubSpot record (or share the Drive link directly).
- Ben: confirm the data retention window and whether the log archive contains request bodies (we prefer redacted).
- Marissa: please include the short attestation language you referenced; procurement will want that for their packet.

We’ll be joined by two folks from Acme: Jordan Lee (security) and Priya Shah (procurement, priya.shah@acmelabs.com). See you on the 23rd.

Elena Marques
Corp Ops Program Manager
Acme Labs
